system.description:
You gain "Daunting Pose" with "Target: Wide Area 2 (Select)". If you do not have "Daunting Pose", it is treated as having obtained it at SR1, but you cannot gain the expanded target range in this case. A dazzling helmet with vibrant red color and elaborate craftsmanship. Its presence is so striking that it captures the attention of everyone around it, even in the middle of a battlefield.
